confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge; no live listings, menus, or booking pages were inspected. Restaurant and cafe anchors are moderately reliable. Accommodation is less certain because of seasonal swings (July is low-to-shoulder season for Cape Town tourism). Cocktail and wine anchors were set against the beer anchor (cocktail about 2.5x beer, wine glass about 1.3x beer) because direct knowledge is weaker. USD values assume roughly 17-19 ZAR per USD. The FX value comes from a search summary of the RBA exchange-rates page; the page itself was not opened directly.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city was used. The basis is South African urban and coastal tourist price levels in ZAR, converted to USD, with lodging tiers reflecting Cape Town's winter tourist market.
